A round that closes no issue gets neither, and records why. Today by hand — closed, invoked, recorded — and the store carries no task linkage, so this file is the only place round, issue and sealed entry are joined; inventing that linkage inside the store would make the diary answer to the changelog. The recap lands in the ISSUE and nowhere else: the diary's own homes are diarium/ and diarium.md.
